address: Shop 082C, East 1 Street, B1F, Fashion Tianhe Plaza, 299 Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Named after hawker stalls in Malaysia, this cheerful little spot in a shopping mall occupies a bold yellow room with Malaysian flags everywhere. With years of history, this is their only shop. The owner also rolls up his sleeves to prepare the country's national dishes, such as laksa (seafood noodle soup) and nasi lemak (coconut rice) served with juicy fried chicken and house-made sambal. For drinks, try the teh C special (three-layer milk tea)....
